_comment: Cumulative Martial Training I-VI progression for non-initiator characters. Index = chain depth - 1 (depth 1 = MT I owned, ... depth 6 = MT VI). Numbers from the d20pfsrd Martial Training I-VI feat texts; where a feat offers '2 maneuvers OR 1 maneuver + 1 stance' (V, VI) the stance is preferred per the campaign spec. No ability-modifier bonuses apply.
